newsitem.title: UK: Viglen shares make market debut.
newsitem.headline: Viglen shares make market debut.

text.p: Shares in Viglen Technology Plc made their market debut on Monday at a discount to some analyst expectations following its creation in a restructuring of Amstrad Plc, traders said.
Viglen shares were quoted at 64-1/2p by 0942 GMT, compared with previous valuations on the stock of around 70p. Volume reached 687,344 shares.

The restructuring of Amstrad and its reincarnation as Viglen was announced in June. Amstrad shareholders received one Viglen share plus a share of Amstrad's Betacom unit, a share in proceeds of litigation over disc drive faults and 163p in loan notes.
Amstrad shares were suspended on July 29 pending court approval of the restructuring.
"There are just a few scrappy sellers around this morning," said one dealer.
